title: Live sync explains HTTP protection and respects Retry-After without resending uncertain writes
steps: Run both sync clients against real HTTP protection responses.
expect: Firewall, HTML challenge, HTTP password and token refusals have distinct codes.
Numeric and HTTP-date Retry-After prevent early retries, including a 120-second delay.
A rate limit never probes another endpoint immediately.

tests: pull: firewall, password, challenge and token refusals remain distinct
push: firewall, password, challenge and token refusals remain distinct
pull: a 429 respects Retry-After and preserves rate-limit classification
push: a 429 respects Retry-After and preserves rate-limit classification
the stand route preserves an HTTP-date Retry-After header for both directions
